verses.text: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.

xrefs.text: Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.

verses.text: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.

xrefs.text: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets.

verses.text: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

xrefs.text: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.
to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
Be advised, therefore, that God’s salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!”

verses.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!

xrefs.text: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!

verses.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.

xrefs.text: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.

Hezekiah stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres according to the command of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and of Nathan the prophet. For the command had come from the LORD through His prophets.

verses.text: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.

xrefs.text: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
They took an oath to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, trumpets, and rams’ horns.
Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.

And Hezekiah ordered that the burnt offering be sacrificed on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD and the trumpets began as well, accompanied by the instruments of David king of Israel.

verses.text: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.

xrefs.text: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; break forth in song, O mountains! For the LORD has comforted His people, and He will have compassion on His afflicted ones.
A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

verses.text: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy

xrefs.text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

verses.text: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

xrefs.text: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.
Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him— even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
